events.factual_description: Jazz House ALFIE's official October 2026 schedule lists Yoshiaki Masuo on guitar and vocals with Mikiko Nagatake on piano, Kunpei Nakabayashi on bass, and Takato Kitai on drums on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. ALFIE states its October operating pattern as doors at 18:45, performance from 19:15 to 20:45, and closing at 23:30; the October 6 listing carries a ¥5,500 music charge. Masuo's current official fan site, endorsed by the artist and management, describes him as a Japanese-born jazz guitarist, composer, arranger and producer who played as Sonny Rollins's guitarist for seven years in total, and says he continues to return to Japan for spring and autumn performance periods with the Yoshiaki Masuo Band active in 2026. Pianist Mikiko Nagatake's October schedule independently lists the same Masuo/Nagatake/Nakabayashi/Kitai quartet at ALFIE on October 6 and at cooljojo on October 5.

en.why_it_matters: Masuo is not here as historical wallpaper. The guitarist who spent years inside Sonny Rollins's band is still bringing a current working quartet back into Tokyo rooms, and ALFIE puts that guitar-piano-bass-drums conversation at close range. The appeal is the continuity: a player tied directly to the transpacific jazz language of the 1970s, heard through an active 2026 band rather than a repertory tribute. If that lineage and a strong guitar-led rhythm section are in your lane, actively make room for this one.
en.trip_verdict: If October 6 falls inside a Tokyo stay, I would build the Roppongi evening around ALFIE. The room and Masuo's current quartet make the cross-city effort worthwhile, but his recurring Japan seasons and the same quartet's October 5 date nearby mean there is no reason to reshape an entire Japan itinerary around this single night.

es.why_it_matters: Masuo no entra aquí como pieza de museo. El guitarrista que pasó años dentro de la banda de Sonny Rollins sigue llevando un cuarteto de trabajo actual a las salas de Tokio, y ALFIE pone esa conversación de guitarra, piano, bajo y batería a pocos metros del público. Lo atractivo es la continuidad: un músico conectado directamente con el lenguaje transpacifico del jazz de los setenta, escuchado a través de una banda activa en 2026 y no de un homenaje de repertorio. Si te interesa esa genealogía y una sección rítmica guiada por la guitarra, sí le haría espacio activamente.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 6 de octubre cae dentro de una estancia en Tokio, armaría la noche de Roppongi alrededor de ALFIE. La sala y el cuarteto actual de Masuo justifican cruzar la ciudad, pero sus temporadas recurrentes en Japón y la fecha del mismo cuarteto el 5 de octubre en otra sala cercana son razones para no reorganizar todo un itinerario por Japón alrededor de esta única noche.
